confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are lower confidence given thinner tourism data and the July low season. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from a third-party site that says it reproduces RBA data. I did not open the rba.gov.au page to verify it, and I could not confirm a later RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-to-upper-tier Latin American capitals such as Buenos Aires and Santiago, adjusted for Montevideo's relatively high local price level and smaller hostel supply.
